## Scientific change

Describe the question, claim revisions, and reason for this contribution.

## Verification boundary

Explain what the evidence establishes, under which assumptions and scope, and
what remains open.

## Checklist

- [ ] Claim and equation references resolve.
- [ ] Dependencies point to the intended committed revisions.
- [ ] Numerical parameters and tolerances are explicit.
- [ ] Formal proofs distinguish encoded premises from physical correspondence.
- [ ] `gitscience audit` passes for every changed study.
- [ ] The central registry compiles and `scripts/validate_registry.py` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` files, or private data are included.
